responses.text: Here to meet with the brass?
You oughtta think about enlisting. We need you here.
Lot of folks at McCarran really appreciate what you've done.
Hope you like it here at McCarran.
Make yourself at home here. It's cozy... for an airport.
Checking in with the base, huh?
I can't believe it's over. I figured the Dam would fall and this place would be our last stand.
Fight's gonna break out at the Dam any time now. Feels strange not being there for it.
The cavalry's finally here. God bless the boys in black.
Word is, our Ranger vets are finally coming up from Baja. The Legion should be pissing their togas.
First Recon is holding Forlorn Hope now. What I wouldn't give for sniper support here.
With both Nelson and Camp Forlorn Hope gone, you have to wonder when McCarran's gonna get attacked.
I've always known Camp Forlorn Hope was a death sentence. I just wish I'd been wrong.
They're saying we retook Nelson. Finally some good news.
Brotherhood's been quiet lately. Guess they finally realized Rangers beat power armor every time.
Heard the Kings have turned over a new leaf. Doesn't mean you'll see me in Freeside any time soon.
I've been seeing a lot of dead Fiends lately. Damn psychos had it coming.
Are you the one that killed Motor-Runner? Thank God. That guy was a living nightmare.
Bad time to lose Chief Hanlon. He'd have had Caesar running scared.
The most important POW we've ever taken and he gets away. He must've had help.
How could we fail to protect our own monorail?
Caesar's dead. So when do we go home?
